To address your concern about sub spam, I know there are several Linux help subs here on voat. Linux4noobs, linuxquestions and linuxhelp come to mind.
IMO these subs should be linked in the sidebar. And probably at the top in a very obvious way.

There are lots of terminals because there are lots of ...well... terminals out there. And yes, in terms of Unix commands they will behave the same. The key thing for commands is which 'shell' you are using. If you're coming from Ubuntu and haven't specifically chosen a shell then you are using 'bash'.

About the terminal, though pick one you like. To my mind they are not much different from eachother. I just use whichever is the default for my desktop environment. There will be a few shortcuts and features that are different between them. I think vanilla ubuntu uses gnome-terminal.

There are a lot of terminal emulators out there. They all function basically the same. Most differ only in apperance and customizability like fonts or transparency. Some fit better aesthetically to certain DEs/WMs. Personally i like xfce4-terminal for DEs and urxvt for WMs.

Most terminal emulators function basically the same.

The difference is what graphical toolkit they use, and what options they have.

Like Konsole has tabs, and is written in Qt.
